description: Give PlatformCreateApplicationTransfer an optional JSON object body. The current official spec (https://github.com/clerk/openapi-specs/blob/94753d1d8a648806e4dc529beec8bb76daa13859/platform/beta.yml) still declares no requestBody for POST /platform/applications/{applicationID}/transfers. Historical live evidence from 2026-10-02 recorded in #701 (https://github.com/wyattjoh/distilled/blob/29a40f857b7b23c789c75a3b139d238c1c493c46/packages/clerk/patches/platform/application-transfer-json-body.patch.json) reports that a bodiless POST without Content-Type returned 415 unsupported_content_type ("You should use application/json instead"), while the same POST with Content-Type: application/json, with or without a {} body, returned 201. This historical behavior was not newly verified. Clerk reads no fields from this body; declaring an optional payload member makes the existing REST request builder send {} with application/json when the caller leaves it unset, without a provider-wide protocol change.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Unused by Clerk. Leave unset; the SDK sends an empty JSON object with Content-Type: application/json.
